properties.description: Consumer team custom role. Allows teams to create and manage metric alert rules in their own subscriptions and reference ME-managed Action Groups cross-subscription. Explicitly blocks creation or modification of Action Groups to prevent bypassing the centralized ME routing model.

actions: Action Groups - READ ONLY (cross-subscription reference to ME-managed AGs)
Must be assigned in BOTH the consumer subscription AND the ME subscription
to allow alert rules to reference ME action groups cross-subscription.
Metric Alert Rules - Full lifecycle in consumer's own subscription
Out of scope: scheduledQueryRules (Log Analytics based) are excluded.
Metrics and metric definitions - needed to configure alert conditions
Policy read access - allows teams to view applicable policy compliance
notActions: Explicitly DENY Action Group write/delete operations.
Teams must use ME-managed Action Groups — they cannot create their own.
This is the enforcement complement to the AIOps Deny Webhook Policy.

_comment.usage: Assign this role at the landing zone management group so it applies to all consumer subscriptions. Also assign 'Microsoft.Insights/actionGroups/read' (this role) at the ME shared-services subscription or resource group level so consumer teams can reference ME-managed Action Groups cross-subscription.
_comment.crossSubscriptionNote: Azure ARM requires the identity creating an alert rule to have actionGroups/read on the target action group's subscription. Without this cross-subscription assignment, alert rule creation will fail even if the AG ARM ID is correct.
_comment.important: Replace <LANDING-ZONE-MANAGEMENT-GROUP-ID> before deployment. Add the ME subscription as an additional assignableScope if needed for the cross-subscription read assignment.
_comment.deploymentNote: To deploy via Azure CLI: az role definition create --role-definition @AIOps-Consumer-AlertRuleContributor-Role.json
